body.sql: WITH latest_complete AS (SELECT DISTINCT ON (location_id) * FROM gym.ezf_active_membership_sync_runs WHERE status = 'complete' AND had_errors = false AND parse_drift = false AND structural_differences = 0 AND unmapped_members = 0 AND unexplained_records = 0 AND report_filter_version = 'ezfacility-memberships-by-status-owner-filters-v1' AND report_as_of IS NOT NULL AND finished_at IS NOT NULL ORDER BY location_id, report_as_of DESC, finished_at DESC, id DESC) SELECT l.id AS location_id, CASE WHEN r.id IS NOT NULL AND COUNT(p.id) = r.source_rows_total AND COUNT(DISTINCT p.source_membership_key) = r.unique_membership_keys AND COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE p.bridge_class = 'MATCHED_INDIVIDUAL' AND p.member_id IS NOT NULL) = r.active_individual_members AND COUNT(DISTINCT p.member_id) FILTER (WHERE p.bridge_class = 'MATCHED_INDIVIDUAL' AND p.member_id IS NOT NULL) = r.active_individual_members THEN COUNT(DISTINCT p.member_id) FILTER (WHERE p.bridge_class = 'MATCHED_INDIVIDUAL' AND p.member_id IS NOT NULL) ELSE NULL END AS active_individual_members, r.report_as_of, MIN(p.source_last_seen_at) AS fetched_at FROM gym.locations l LEFT JOIN latest_complete r ON r.location_id = l.id LEFT JOIN gym.ezf_active_memberships p ON p.location_id = r.location_id AND p.report_as_of = r.report_as_of AND p.source_csv_sha256 = r.source_csv_sha256 GROUP BY l.id, r.id, r.source_rows_total, r.unique_membership_keys, r.active_individual_members, r.report_as_of ORDER BY l.id
